# `st_setsrid`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a new GEOGRAPHY or GEOMETRY value whose SRID is the specified SRID value.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
st_setsrid(geo, srid)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `st_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- st_setsrid, example 1
> SELECT st_srid(st_setsrid(ST_GeogFromWKB(X'0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040'), 4326));
4326
```

```sql
-- st_setsrid, example 2
> SELECT st_srid(st_setsrid(ST_GeomFromWKB(X'0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040'), 3857));
3857
```
